label: archive.sh cp+mv+rm moves packets and refreshes only parent track metadata; the moved packet's own description.json specFolder and graph-metadata paths go stale - direct producer of METADATA_DISK_PATH_CONSISTENCY (2898 baseline)

templates/core/spec.md.tmpl opens ANCHOR:questions at :184 for all levels and closes at :399 (L1/2/3) or :425 (L3+), nesting nfr/edge-cases/complexity inside questions for L2; fresh scaffold sample reproduces it
validation-rules.md:392 forbids anchor nesting and ANCHORS_VALID checks pairing/order/uniqueness, so the shipping template still mints ANCHORS_VALID on every new L1/2/3 spec.md

create.sh replace_template_default_trigger_phrases rewrites only the four known template default phrase blocks per doc kind, deriving phrases from slug+description with a stop-word trim shared with the cleanup tool

create.sh generates per-folder description.json (warn-not-fail when generator missing) and writes phase-map anchors into parent specs - create-time writes are the origin of much later-drifted metadata

Contradiction: archive.sh deliberately never prunes phase-parent children_ids (documented reviewed-prune design at :296-301) while GRAPH_METADATA_CHILD_IDENTITY flags stale listings - needs a documented prune path, not silent rewrite
